description: This file contains the 'DatabaseUtil' class, which provides utilities for managing and examining database schemas within the context of the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving database metadata, checking and updating database schemas, and inducing model entities from the database schemas.

classes.name: DatabaseUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for examining, verifying, and maintaining database schemas, especially within the OFBiz framework. Includes static initialization for detection features and various methods for schema introspection, schema modification, and model induction.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes a new JDBC connection, optionally registering the driver if specified.

methods.name: makeTempFieldName
methods.description: Generates a temporary unique field name based on a ModelField, with length restrictions.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a connection based on helper configuration, handling transaction contexts and legacy setups.

methods.name: checkDb
methods.description: Verifies the database schema against model entities, optionally adding missing columns, foreign keys, and indexes.

methods.name: induceModelFromDb
methods.description: Inspects a connected database to produce a list of ModelEntity objects that represent the current schema.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Retrieves the database schema name via JDBC metadata.

methods.name: getIsCaseSensitive
methods.description: Determines if the database identifiers are case-sensitive.

methods.name: getDatabaseMetaData
methods.description: Obtains the metadata object for the current database connection.

methods.name: printDbMiscData
methods.description: Logs miscellaneous database metadata information for debugging.

methods.name: getTableNames
methods.description: Fetches the list of table names from the database, including views and synonyms.

methods.name: getColumnInfo
methods.description: Gathers column metadata for a set of tables, including types and nullability.

methods.name: makeIndexClause
methods.description: Constructs SQL statement for creating an index on a ModelEntity based on a ModelIndex.

methods.name: deleteDeclaredIndices
methods.description: Deletes all declared indices for a specified ModelEntity.

methods.name: deleteDeclaredIndices
methods.description: Deletes all declared indices for a specified ModelEntity, accumulating messages.

methods.name: deleteDeclaredIndex
methods.description: Deletes a specified index from a ModelEntity's table.

methods.name: createForeignKeyIndices
methods.description: Creates foreign key indices for a ModelEntity, with optional constraint name length and message list handling.

methods.name: createForeignKeyIndices
methods.description: Creates foreign key indices for a ModelEntity, with specified constraint name length and message list.

methods.name: createForeignKeyIndex
methods.description: Creates a foreign key index for a specific ModelRelation.

methods.name: makeFkIndexClause
methods.description: Constructs SQL clause for foreign key index creation based on a ModelRelation.

methods.name: deleteForeignKeyIndices

methods.name: deleteForeignKeyIndices
methods.description: Deletes foreign key indices for a ModelEntity, with optional constraint name length.

methods.name: deleteForeignKeyIndex

methods.name: deleteForeignKeyIndex

methods.name: updateCharacterSetAndCollation
methods.description: Updates the character set and collation of a table and its string fields based on datasource info.

methods.description: Stores metadata about a table column, including name, type, nullability, and key information.

methods.name: ReferenceCheckInfo
